questions.text: You ________ if you don't want to miss the bus.
questions.explication: « Had better + base verbale » (sans « to »).

questions.text: I wouldn't mind ________ outside.
questions.explication: « Mind + gérondif ».

questions.text: We would have bought a new car if we ________ enough money.
questions.explication: Troisième conditionnel : « if + plus-que-parfait » (« had had »).

questions.text: She has studied English ________.
questions.explication: « For » + une durée avec le present perfect (« since » s'utilise avec un point de départ précis).

questions.text: Is your book ________?
questions.explication: « The same as » est la structure comparative correcte.

questions.text: Abdou isn't ________ to be a soldier.
questions.explication: L'ordre correct est « adjectif + enough ».

questions.text: Aziz is only 16. He wishes he ________ ten years older.
questions.explication: « Wish + prétérit modal (were) » pour un souhait irréel présent.

questions.text: She made her daughter ________ her homework before going to bed.
questions.explication: « Make someone + base verbale » (causatif « make », sans « to »).

questions.text: Dad had the T.V. set ________, so we can watch our favourite film today.
questions.explication: « Have something done » (causatif, participe passé).

questions.text: Let's forget our troubles, ________?
questions.explication: Le tag standard après « Let's » est « shall we? ».

questions.text: I will never get used to his ________ out every night.
questions.explication: « Be/get used to + gérondif ».

questions.text: Don't let her ________ all these horror films.
questions.explication: « Let someone + base verbale » (causatif « let »).

questions.text: That school was too far for ________ to arrive on time.
questions.explication: « For + pronom complément + infinitif » : « me ».

questions.text: Your hair needs ________.
questions.explication: « Need + gérondif » a un sens passif (« needs cutting » = a besoin d'être coupé).

questions.text: She'd rather he ________ another one, but it's too late now.
questions.explication: « Would rather + sujet + plus-que-parfait » pour exprimer un regret sur le passé (« it's too late now »).

questions.text: I must not forget ________ my wheel!
questions.explication: « Forget + to + infinitif » (oublier de faire quelque chose).

questions.text: Don't worry, there's enough ________ for all our guests.
questions.explication: « Enough + to + infinitif » (« there's enough to eat »).

questions.text: He wanted the letter ________ immediately.
questions.explication: « Want something to be done » (infinitif passif).

questions.text: A person who takes pictures is ________.
questions.explication: Une personne qui prend des photos est un(e) « photographer ».

questions.text: The thing you type on on a computer is ________.
questions.explication: On tape (« type ») sur un « keyboard » (clavier).
